The '''1997–98''' season was '''[[Chelsea F.C.]]'s''' 84th competitive season, their 9th consecutive season in the English top flight and 92nd year as a club.

==Season summary==
With conceding goals being a major issue last season, Chelsea signed [[Netherlands|Dutch]] international goalkeeper [[Ed de Goey]], who proved to be a relative success. Chelsea's only other major signings were young [[Norway|Norwegian]] striker [[Tore Andre Flo]] and [[Uruguay]]an international midfielder [[Gustavo Poyet]] from [[Real Zaragoza]], who added more goals from an otherwise very defensive midfield. Chelsea were well on course for a top-five finish and success in the [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup]] and the [[Football League Cup|League Cup]] when manager [[Ruud Gullit]] was sacked on 12 February following a dispute with chairman [[Ken Bates]]. His job went to 33-year-old striker [[Gianluca Vialli]], who took on the role of player-manager and achieved instant success - within three months of his appointment, Vialli had guided the Blues to glory on the continent and at Wembley. This success gave Chelsea fans hope that [[1998-99 in English football|the following season]] could spell the end of their title wait which began in 1955.
